title: Garlic Aioli with Boiled Potatoes and Vegetables
summary: Pasteurised yolks whisked with lemon and garlic, then sunflower and olive oil worked in by hand, served with boiled vegetables.

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, crushed to a paste
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Boil the potatoes in unsalted water for 15-20 min until a knife slides in, adding the beans and carrots for the last 4-5 min. Drain.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Set the bowl on a twisted damp towel and whisk the yolks, lemon juice, garlic, salt and sugar together.

steps.title: Add the oil
steps.text: Whisking all the time, add the sunflower oil drop by drop at first, then in a thin stream, then the olive oil, until thick and glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season and serve the aioli with the warm potatoes, beans and carrots.

tips: Remove any green shoot from the garlic for a milder taste.
Mixing in sunflower oil stops the sauce tasting bitter.
safety: Use pasteurised eggs; pregnant women, young children, older people and anyone unwell should skip raw-egg sauces.
For a cooked-yolk version, heat the yolks with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water over simmering water to 71 °C first.
storage: Keep the aioli covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
